description: Lists emails the workspace's agents sent or scheduled, newest first, with recipients, subject, status and timestamps. Filters by agent, thread or text in the subject, body or recipient addresses; `next_cursor` fetches the next page.

agent_id.description: Filter by agent id or name. A key tied to one agent always reads that agent's mail, and naming another agent is a 403.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous page's `next_cursor`.

q.description: Case-insensitive substring of the subject, body or recipient addresses. For word search across all mail, use GET /v1/search.

name: mails_emails_list
title: List sent emails
